rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Automates the pipeline of finding, evaluating, and installing skills for coding agents. Searches across multiple registries in parallel, applies trust scoring based on five dimensions including git quality metrics, performs security scanning before installation, and manages skill lifecycle with dead-skill detection. Includes context cherry-picking for partial skill loading.
